item.title: Sat, Apr 3 · 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM — [31] Figure Drawing Workshop
item.description: Location: VMFA Studio School, 200 N Arthur Ashe Boulevard, Richmond, VA 23220 | Cost: $80 (member price) | One-session workshop with instructor Amy Smith. Students study drawings of the human form, then work from a live model to create expressive portraits in charcoal and pencil. Prerequisite: basic drawing skills.
